title: The Trauma Plot to Destroy America
gist: A review of Catherine Liu's Traumatized, a Marxist critique arguing that the 'trauma plot' — framing poverty and overwork as private psychological wounds addressed by therapy, self-help and corporate wellness — commodifies suffering and suppresses class politics. The reviewer finds it persuasive but historically narrow, and suggests new foreign tech regulation (youth social media bans, algorithmic transparency) could blunt the U.S. 'surveillance capitalism' that monetizes confession.

themes.theme: Trauma plot as commodified class control

insights.claim: Catherine Liu argues capitalism treats poverty, overwork and insecurity as individual traumas to be overcome via self-help, therapy and corporate wellness, turning the psychological wounds of exploitation into profitable, commoditized stories and shifting responsibility onto workers.
